desc:
🌈 Balance Update! Heavenly Amulets are now truly obtainable 🌈

🌈 Heavenly Amulets can drop from Dong Saming digs and the Wolf Leader Boss (collector item - trade only)
💎 Rare amulets are harder to find = worth more
🔐 Tougher locks in the Graveyard & Dong Saming
⛏️ Fewer digs - read the clues and test your luck
👻 Ghosts in the abandoned village and graveyard are much stronger
💰 Quick Sell now pays 80% - negotiate at buyer shops for better prices
🔊 Softer sounds, calmer mall lights, BUY / SELL signs in the mall

🔍 Amulet Master Simulator
Search for amulets, distinguish real ones from fakes, buy, sell, and collect rare amulets.
🐅 Dong Saming: PvP forest - die and you drop your forest bag!
🧘 Train at the Temple / Black Sect Academy
🎲 Roll Family & Talents to boost your power
📢 Press the round button under Shop to see what's new
📘 Press F3 for the in-game guide
